title: Zippers can be flimsy
text: Zippers can be flimsy. Just got these today. Very light weight, good to carry heavy blankets around, fabric seems alright. But zippers came off because the closings at the edge were not done tightly...

product_metadata.title: 90L Under Bed Storage Bag with Zips, 2 PCS Duvet Storage Bag King Size, Thick Breathable Fabric Underbed Storage Bags with Clear Windows, Clothing Storage Bags for Quilt, Bedding, Blankets
features: 【UPGRADED BREATHABLE FABRIC】:Storage bag made from breathable, odorless non-woven fabric, promotes ventilation and protects your stored articles from moisture and dust, pest, water damage.
【LARGE CAPACITY】: The underbed storage bags size 39.4x19.7x7.1 inch (100x50x18 cm), Can be used blanket storage，clothes storage，toys, comforters etc...
【THICK STRONG HANDLES】: Both sides of the storage bag handle is sewn with two layers of thick fabric, and the load-bearing capacity is doubled, will not make your hands pain, Easy to carry.

【BIG CLEAR WINDOW】: Our clothes storage bag has a see through panel so that you can see what you have inside without having to opening the bag. The top transparent PVC cover is waterproof and moisture resistant.
